"Tracking says delivered to the wrong state, seller seems nice but no refund yet. What now?"

sloth_on_a_budget:
Seller being responsive is a good sign, but don't close the case just because they're nice. Nothing is decided until the money actually shows up in your PayPal activity. You've got 20 days from when you opened it to escalate to a claim, so if they haven't refunded or the dress hasn't shown up by a few days before the deadline, escalate. With a delivered scan in a different state and your address on the order, you'd very likely win. Screenshot the tracking page now in case it changes.
